dialogues.speaker: Woland
dialogues.text: Yes, my friend. I am from Mondstadt, and I've been active in the Mondstadt chapter of the Adventurers' Guild for a while now...

dialogues.speaker: Woland
dialogues.text: I've been asked to make a few presentations at Guild headquarters, and I will meet a few friends on the side too. That's why I'm on this train.
